acceptance_tests: ERC run reports 0 errors, warnings justified (from baseline 10 errors / 8 warnings)
DRC run against generic_two_layer reports 0 errors, warnings justified (from baseline 5 errors / 13 warnings)
Netlist check: all power_in pins (U1.1, U1.2, U2.1, U2.2) connected; VBUS, +3V3, GND driven with PWR_FLAG coverage
+3V3 measured 3.20-3.40 V at 0 mA and 500 mA load, ripple < 50 mV pk-pk
I2C scan detects TMP102 at 0x48; reading within +/-2 degC of reference
USB-C host connection boots the board with average draw < 500 mA
Board fits within 110 x 65 mm outline with >= 1.0 mm copper-to-edge clearance
Gerber, drill, BOM, and pick-and-place outputs generate without errors
constraints: Two-layer generic_two_layer manufacturer profile only; no blind/buried vias or controlled impedance
Board outline fixed at (35,35) to (145,100) => 110 x 65 mm maximum
Minimum trace/clearance 0.2 mm, minimum drill 0.3 mm
USB-C receptacle must be edge-mounted and mechanically flush with the outline
ESP32-WROOM-32 antenna keep-out must have no copper or components beneath or within 15 mm in front
Existing USB_B_Micro symbol must be replaced by a USB-C receptacle to satisfy the USB-C power request
VBUS current limited to 500 mA (USB default sink, no PD negotiation)
Proposal-only stage: no project files, schematic, or layout may be modified

power.input: USB-C VBUS 5 V nominal (4.75-5.25 V), regulated to +3V3 by an LDO

requirements.statement: The board shall be powered from a USB-C receptacle providing VBUS at 5 V nominal (4.75-5.25 V).
USB-C CC1 and CC2 pins shall each be terminated to GND with 5.1 kOhm resistors to advertise a default 5 V/500 mA sink.
A 3.3 V LDO regulator shall convert VBUS to the +3V3 rail with output tolerance within +/-3%.
The +3V3 rail shall supply at least 600 mA continuous to cover ESP32 Wi-Fi transmit peaks.
Total board current draw from VBUS shall not exceed 500 mA average to stay within USB default sink budget.
The +3V3 rail shall have bulk decoupling of at least 10 uF plus 100 nF within 5 mm of U1 pin 1 and 100 nF within 2 mm of U2 pin 1.
VBUS input shall include a 1 uF minimum input capacitor and reverse/ESD protection at the connector.
Exactly one PWR_FLAG shall be attached to each externally sourced net (VBUS and GND) and the regulator output net +3V3 shall be driven by a power_out pin or PWR_FLAG so ERC power-driver checks pass.
All power_in pins (U1.1, U1.2, U2.1, U2.2) shall be connected to a driven power net; no power_in pin may remain unconnected.
The board shall provide one I2C bus at 3.3 V logic connecting U1.GPIO21 (SDA) and U1.GPIO22 (SCL) to U2.SDA and U2.SCL.
SDA and SCL shall each have a 4.7 kOhm pull-up resistor to +3V3.
The I2C bus shall operate at up to 400 kHz (fast mode) with total bus capacitance below 400 pF.
U2.ADD0 shall be strapped to GND through a 10 kOhm resistor to fix the TMP102 address at 0x48.
USB D+ and D- shall be routed as a 90 Ohm differential pair from the USB-C receptacle to U1.USB_D+/U1.USB_D-, with length matching within 5 mm.
The EN pin (U1.8) shall be pulled to +3V3 through 10 kOhm with a 100 nF capacitor to GND for reset timing, and shall not be tied directly to the +3V3 net symbol.
Unused or unrouted GPIO pins (e.g. U1.GPIO25) shall be either routed to a test point/header or marked no-connect so ERC reports zero unconnected-pin errors.
The finished board shall not exceed 110 mm x 65 mm, matching outline (35,35) to (145,100).
The PCB shall be a 2-layer 1.6 mm FR-4 stackup with 1 oz copper.
The USB-C receptacle shall be placed on a board edge with its mating face flush to the outline (within 0.5 mm) and no components inside its keep-out.
All component courtyards shall lie fully inside the board outline with a minimum 1.0 mm edge clearance for copper.
The temperature sensor U2 shall be placed at least 15 mm from the LDO and the ESP32 module to reduce self-heating error.
Minimum trace width shall be 0.2 mm and minimum copper-to-copper clearance 0.2 mm.
Minimum drill size shall be 0.3 mm with 0.6 mm minimum via pad diameter and 0.15 mm annular ring.
Power traces carrying up to 600 mA (VBUS and +3V3) shall be at least 0.4 mm wide.
Silkscreen shall not overlap pads, minimum silkscreen line width 0.15 mm and text height 0.8 mm.
The bottom layer shall carry a continuous GND pour with stitching vias not more than 20 mm apart.
Output package shall include Gerbers (RS-274X), drill files, BOM, and pick-and-place files.
Bill of materials cost shall not exceed 15 USD per board at 10-unit quantity.
Bare-board fabrication shall use only standard generic_two_layer process options with no controlled impedance, blind vias, or extra finishes.
Total distinct part count shall not exceed 20 line items to limit assembly cost.
The board shall operate over 0 to 70 degC ambient (commercial range).
Temperature measurement accuracy shall be within +/-0.5 degC over 0 to 65 degC.
LDO junction temperature rise shall stay below 40 degC above ambient at 500 mA load with 1.7 V dropout, requiring thermal relief copper of at least 100 mm2.
KiCad ERC shall report 0 errors and all remaining warnings shall be individually justified (baseline 10 errors / 8 warnings).
KiCad DRC against generic_two_layer rules shall report 0 errors and all remaining warnings shall be individually justified (baseline 5 errors / 13 warnings).
Measured +3V3 rail shall be 3.20-3.40 V with no load and under 500 mA load, with ripple below 50 mV peak-to-peak.
The TMP102 shall be readable at I2C address 0x48 and return a temperature within +/-2 degC of a reference thermometer.
The board shall enumerate/boot when connected to a USB-C host and shall draw less than 500 mA average.
Netlist review shall confirm zero unconnected pins and zero floating power nets (VBUS, +3V3, GND all driven).
